content: Client-side resize VERIFIED pattern: createImageBitmap(file) — imageOrientation:'from-image' is the DEFAULT in the current spec, EXIF orientation baked into bitmap on Chrome 81+/Safari 13.1+/Firefox 77+; draw to canvas, canvas.toBlob('image/jpeg',0.85) — canvas output has no EXIF so server autoOrient is a harmless no-op (double safety). HEIC: iOS Safari file picker with accept=image/* auto-transcodes HEIC→JPEG on selection (iOS 13+); Safari decodes HEIC natively in canvas; non-WebKit browsers CANNOT decode HEIC — sharp cannot either (no libheif) → error copy path. Never manually rotate by EXIF on modern browsers (double-rotation trap)
